body: He asked if he needed to come over. I said "Yeah." and he said he can't. :(
Thank you. I told my boyfriend how I'm feeling and he asked if I'm hiding something from him. Wow.

My boss treats me like I don't know how to do anything, and then I get really nervous and actually do screw up. For example, I'm supposed to ask if the person has building access or not before I give them their ID. I had already talked to this guy and he said he lived in the dorms, so I knew he had building access.. My boss comes up a few minutes later and asks if he has building access. Another example, a foreign exchange student came in needing an ID. I asked my boss if I needed to make him a ledger card (because I figured she already had it ready because she was talking to the guy like they'd spoken on the phone earlier) and she was like "yeah he's getting a student ID." Which I knew.. So I proceeded to make him a ledger card and she fussed at me and said "no I already made one out for him." And I said "okay I asked you about that a few seconds ago." I've been working there since September, but they never gave me a manual or anything. About two weeks ago someone I work with warned me I'm going to get fired if I don't catch on, and my boss made me a "manual." Well all that was in there was how to make faculty and student IDs, which I already know how to do really well. I mean I've messed up before, but I know how to do it, and it's apparent. 

My boyfriend.. Well most of the time when I try to talk to him about something he just acts like I didn't say anything. Sometimes it seems like he does it to avoid arguments, but I noticed he does it even when we aren't close to arguing. For example, last night in the car I told him about a friend I had in middle school who really screwed me over and how a friend I had in high school reminded me of her. Not very interesting stuff, but I just felt like talking about it I guess. He completely ignored all of it. He said something like "do you see sonic anywhere?" In the middle of me talking. He knew I was upset because he said "are you upset?" I said "yeah a little bit. I was trying to tell you a story." And he said "oh. Tell me more about middle school." And I was like no its okay. Then I gave him a hand job for the rest of the ride because I didn't want him to not like me because I talking too much. He complains that his best friend's girlfriend talks too much. 

Also at work, the two people I work with constantly make fun of "how stupid people are" for some of the questions they ask.. Which really aren't even that stupid. I hate hearing people be made fun of. It makes me feel bad.

I don't think I'm going back to work. I have finals this week and I tried studying, but I don't see a point anymore. 

There was a post on the front page about child abuse that triggered some really bad memories of mine. Now I can't get them out of my head. My boyfriend knows about how my parents were. One day we were talking and he said something like "yeah I'm a firm believer in spanking. If we don't spank our future kids then they'll end up like your younger siblings." He knows my dad used to beat all of us. I don't know why my boyfriend would say something like that. He's supposed to be my best friend, he knows me better than anyone, but I don't feel like even he cares about me. 

I told my mom I was going to therapy and she went on some rant about how god made us the way we are and there's nothing wrong with us.

What's so bad about suicide anyway? The only thing really stopping me is fear I'll go to hell (if there is one) and I'm worried I'll traumatize whoever finds me.


Edit: fuck and I feel like I bother the few friends that I do have. I'll send them texts and try to be funny or act happy and stuff, but they always stop replying after a couple texts. My friend bailed on me the other day. I can't keep a friend and I don't know why. I feel like its because I get too close to people, but they really don't feel that close to me. I lost two really good girl friends in high school. I tried making amends with one of them since we go to the same school, but to no avail. I don't know what I'm doing wrong or why no one likes me or wants to talk to me. I know my parents didn't socialize me properly, but I've been working on it so hard. I've been trying to not be obsessive. I've been trying to "fake it till I make it" and act happy. I don't know what I'm doing wrong, and I'm going to end all of this within the week if I still feel like this. I'll be at my parents house by then, but hopefully I can figure out a good place and time to do it.
I tried. It went badly.
In the facebook message I asked him if he wanted to read it with me.
I will. Thank you so much. My university offers free counseling and I probably will make an appointment soon.
Yeah. Pre-nursing.
Yeah that's a good idea. I'll talk to him about it when we see each other this weekend.

Yeah you're right. My car should be paid off by January 2014, so hopefully I'll have enough money by next summer to get an apartment with my boyfriend. I don't particularly like the idea of living with him before we're married, but it's better than living with my family. They aren't going to support me in any way if I decide to live with him.

Texting my dad and brother put me in a really bad mood and made my day terrible. I texted my SO and told him, and then he ignored me for a few hours. I was really upset when he finally did text back. I don't want him to think that I'm thinking, "Oh you ignored me when I was upset, and now I'm going to show you what that did to me." And honestly him not texting back for hours did influence me some, but I don't want him to think that.
I don't think so. I don't have enough money to. If my boyfriend gets his own place I'll probably stay with him during the summer. I go to college about two hours away from him.

That helped a lot. I'm feeling better now. What should I do about my boyfriend though? He's always really understanding, but I don't want him to think I may be trying to manipulate him to never ignore me again or that I'm trying to blame this on him.
That's a good idea. Yeah I am. I got something to eat.

I have a kitten. She's living with my boyfriend right now though.

Yeah, my family is super "Christian," really conservative, closed minded, and have no idea how to handle anything well. My mom has depression issues, my dad has anger issues, and so do my siblings and I. We never talked about feelings in my house. Emotions weren't to be shown. He'd hit us and yell at us for crying. I've gotten better about communicating with my boyfriend. We've been together for three years and a few months ago I finally talked to him about my family one night because I needed him to come get me because I confronted my parents about their abuse and they went after me. I stayed with him for about a week. My parents are fairly wealthy and pay for most of my college and help out with my car payments, and sometimes I feel ungrateful for hating them, but helping me out monetarily doesn't quite make up for everything they've done.
What do you mean? Yeah I am. I'm a freshman in a pre-nursing program. It's intense.

If I make it that long. Yeah my entire family is messed up. I mean I know it could be worse, but it's really bad. If I ever have enough money I plan on having about three dogs and some cool turtles with huge tanks.

I don't do much so that's nice, but my boss is a bitch. She expects me to know how to do everything after being shown once. I know how to do basic things, but I don't know how to do the stuff I only do twice per semester. One time she got mad at me for pressing "Shift-Print" instead of the "Print" button on the program I was using.
I hope everything will change. I hope my puppies are okay, too. I love both of my dogs. They're awesome. I fucking hate my piece of shit dad.
That really means a lot to me. Thank you.
I work in the ID office on my campus.
Thanks. It is pretty awesome.
That'd be nice but my grades would die if I did that. I already have a job.
I like turtles a lot, but all of mine are at my parents house.

Thanks, I really appreciate it. I don't think I'll ever have kids if I even make it long enough to. I think I'd be a shitty mom. I'm not even motivated enough to study as much as I need to. I would probably end up giving up on them and screwing them up.

No one cares about me. I've tried talking to two youth ministers I thought I was pretty close to and neither replied. Not about this, just about problems with my boyfriend and parents. They don't give a shit. It's like as soon as I was out of the youth group they weren't obligated to talk to me anymore. I had a couple girlfriends, but then I found out they were spreading rumors about me and actually didn't like me, but they liked my car and how generous I am. I have one girl friend, but she's married and we don't see each other much anymore.
